messages.text:
At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy for the shot at a full block, 3.125 BTC, drawn every ten minutes for years, plus steady sats to their own wallet.

What do you pay per kWh?
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30

Free power changes everything — every sat is yours, and you want the most hashrate per dollar.

That's the Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W, tunable to 50 TH/s in Turbo. Best value per TH we sell. Ships November 21, 2026.

Where would it run — desk or garage?

Honest answer: the 40T is about 50 dB even in Eco — a box fan running all night, plus 650 W of heat. Most people don't sleep next to one.

The Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360–450 W, is the calmer one for a room you sleep in. Still around 50 dB though.

Is a closet or garage an option, or does it have to be the bedroom?
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe++ Bitaxe desktop miner

Then I'd drop the big ones. 650 W of heat and a box-fan hum next to your bed gets old fast.

The NerdQX is the one people actually sleep beside: 8 TH/s, ~145 W, ~40 dB, $299.99. Real solo miner, same block draws, just quiet.

Want me to check it ships to your country?

context.pop: Looking for a home Bitcoin miner? I can help you pick one.
